hero.description: Looking west from Hayman Avenue toward the site of the former Southern Railway Passenger Depot (in the vegetation at the top of the small hill) in Lexington, Kentucky, United States.  The depot was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1987; although destroyed, it has not yet been removed from the Register.
